description:
Outer-planet missions (Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto) in /fly show 'NaN km/s' in the HUD velocity readout the entire flight

Expected: HUD displays a finite speed value in km/s for every mission, computed from vis-viva using the correct heliocentric semi-major axis for the actual destination body

Acceptance criteria:
- heliocentricKms is a finite number (not NaN, not ±∞) at every simDay for a Jupiter-bound mission (e.g. galileo, juno, juice) [code-invariant: the app must not display NaN — the e2e test (fly-render-validation.spec.ts Layer 4) already asserts 'All readouts are finite numbers (no NaN, no ±∞)' for Mars/Moon cases; the same invariants must hold for outer-planet missions]
- heliocentricKms is a finite number for a Saturn-bound mission (cassini, voyager-1) [code-invariant: same invariant as above]
- heliocentricKms is a finite number for an outer-system flyby (neptune: voyager-2, pluto: new-horizons, ceres: dawn) [code-invariant: same invariant as above]
- The hardcoded (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2 transfer SMA on line 952 of +page.svelte is replaced by a destination-aware value derived from the mission's active destination (DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a) [repo-data: static/data/planets.json — planets Jupiter (a=5.20336), Saturn (a=9.53707), Uranus (a=19.19126), Neptune (a=30.06896), plus Pluto (a=39.482 via small-bodies.json); also DESTINATIONS map in lambert-grid.constants.ts has all DestinationId entries with their .a values]
- The e2e test cases for outer-planet missions (galileo/jupiter, cassini/saturn, voyager-2/neptune) satisfy the same Layer 4a finite check that the existing Mars/Moon cases already pass [spec: fly-render-validation.spec.ts Layers 3+4: 'All readouts are finite numbers (no NaN, no ±∞)']

Domain facts:
- Jupiter a=5.20336 AU, Saturn a=9.53707 AU, Uranus a=19.19126 AU, Neptune a=30.06896 AU, Pluto a=39.482 AU (from planets.json / small-bodies.json)
- The vis-viva equation v = sqrt(µ · (2/r - 1/a)) produces NaN when r > 2a (i.e. the argument becomes negative)
